ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping tool that instantly transforms on-the-spot hackathon challenge prompts into modular boilerplate web applications using local LLMs.
ideas.title: SpotBuild AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the exact friction point judges care about in surprise-prompt hackathons: execution speed and rapid scaffolding.

ideas.pitch: An engineering lifecycle and knowledge intelligence platform capturing developer context in real time to instantly onboard team members.
ideas.title: OnboardFlow AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a proven first-place architectural pattern from recent AI hackathons focusing on developer tooling and knowledge management.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first AI code reviewer and security guardrail designed for edge deployment during tight live-coding constraints.
ideas.title: CodeShield AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets developer pain points with local automated testing, bug-fixing GUI, and code completion features.

ideas.pitch: A dynamic LLM routing system that intelligently sends sub-tasks to the most cost-effective and accurate open-source or commercial models.
ideas.title: QueryRouter AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep system engineering and cost optimization, which technical judges heavily reward over simple UI wrappers.
